title: Merging an exercise does nothing when the app cannot read the two exercises
what: On an exercise's page, Merge opens a list to pick the exercise to merge into. Before asking, the app checks the two exercises. If that check fails to read, the tap is simply ignored: no question, no message, nothing logged. The list stays open and the member does not know why nothing happened.
expected: A failed check says the merge could not start and to try again, and the reason is logged.
fix_line: Show 'Couldn't merge them, try again' when the check fails, and log it.

title: Tapping Undo after deleting a body weight or measurement can fail with no word
what: After deleting or changing an entry on the Body page, a bar offers Undo. If putting the entry back fails, the failure is thrown away: the bar closes, the page reloads without the entry, and nothing tells the member or records the error. The member believes it came back when it did not.
expected: A failed Undo says the entry could not be brought back and keeps the Undo offer (or logs it), so the member can enter it again.
fix_line: Tell the member when Undo fails and log the reason.

title: If progress photos cannot be read, the Body page invites you to add your first photo
what: The Body page reads progress photos separately from weights. If that read fails, the failure is dropped and the page shows the empty 'Add a progress photo' box, as if the member had none. Nothing is logged and the page is not read again on its own.
expected: A failed photo read says the photos could not be shown, with Try again, and is logged.
fix_line: Show a 'could not load photos' line with Try again instead of the empty box.
